character: speckled rainbow trout in a huge fur coat, two pectoral fins, one dorsal, one tail and nothing else, proud stubborn face, her own female voice
cast: a fat carp in a gold chain riding the current belly up, never a fin stroke, she clears him at 4.4; an old thief, fur hat, grey beard, at the lens from 6.6, net in both arms, never speaks
motion_rule: one leads every window, the trout, driving with her whole body; each move fills its window and the next starts the instant it ends, nothing settles; props and carp move only because she hit them; the thief moves only from 6.6
camera_moves: one take with her, shot size changes five times
props: coin mound going soft and steaming under her fins; a jet firing packed snow, low granite rim; her fur coat until 2.4 then gone; the net from 6.6; a crown from 7.4
environment: city fountain at a mall entrance, blazing noon sun, heavy snow pouring through the sunlight and steaming where it lands

audio.delivery: human female voice from the trout herself, weary deadpan pride, 4.4 syllables per second, never hurried, native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: the line runs continuously from 0.5 and ends on течения at 6.6, one unbroken phrase per window, no breath at the joins 0.5-1.9, 2.4-4.4, 5.0-6.6; mouth opens on every syllable; not one word is added or repeated, after 6.6 she says nothing but a wordless laugh at 7.4 in the same voice

timeline.a: explodes out of the coin mound into the lens in her fur coat, snow through the sun
slams her tail into the change under her, the coins going soft and running away
slaps the melting money with her pectoral fin, steam blasting over the lens
spins on the spot, whipping the fur coat off over her head, it flies at the lens and goes to steam
turns her whole body on the spot, driving a wave across the melting coins
hammers her tail through the coin puddles, molten money flung up in steam
launches backwards clean over the fat carp in the gold chain sliding the other way, into the jet, which fires packed snow over her back
rams her snout into the pounding jet, body arching
hammers her tail on the spot, snout in the jet, the water shoving her back
the old thief swings his net through the water and scoops her out in one snap, she thrashes across the mesh
her whole body turns to solid gold metal, scales, fins and tail, a crown snapping on her head, she grins into the lens, laughs and flicks a kiss off her lips with a pectoral fin
the gold fish bursts into a shoal of tiny goldfish that pour through the mesh past his face, the net empty
he claws at the back of his head, then yanks his jacket shut, the shoal glittering behind him
he drags his hat down over his eyes and stamps off past the lens, empty net swinging, furious

must_appear: the shoal pouring through the mesh; his empty net and angry walk off
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, hard cut, slow motion, slow speech, any Russian word outside the lines, a repeated word, speech after 6.6, human arms on the trout, extra limbs, extra fins, floating props, a held macro with nothing moving, no fish in frame, two mouths at once, male voice, the old man speaking, accented Russian, a second full size trout, a second carp, a second old man, her coat back on after 2.4, gold on her before 7.4, only the crown gold, the net still holding her after 8.9, the old man catching the shoal
